user.title: Connect to Portainer
user.description: Use a Portainer access token (My account > Access tokens). Monitoring only reads; management actions can be turned on later in the options.

reauth_confirm.title: Portainer token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new Portainer access token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Portainer at that URL
error.no_endpoints: Portainer has no environments that are up
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the Home Assistant log

abort.already_configured: This Portainer environment is already set up

data.update_history: Record recent updates from Gantry / Watchtower

data_description.image_check: Asks Portainer to compare each running image with its registry. Read-only; nothing is pulled.
data_description.image_check_interval: Each check queries the registry once per image, so keep this infrequent.
data_description.standalone_containers: Containers on the nodes that are not part of a swarm service, such as ones started with docker run or compose.
data_description.update_history: Reads the logs of a Gantry service or Watchtower container in this environment every 15 minutes and keeps the last 25 updates.
data_description.management: Adds restart and redeploy buttons and lets the swarm_containers actions restart, redeploy, stop, start, scale and remove stacks, services and containers, and drain nodes. The token needs a Portainer user that may change this environment.

restart.name: Restart
restart.description: Restarts a stack, service or container. Services are restarted the way `docker service update --force` does (rolling, following the service's update config); a stack restarts all its services or containers.

redeploy_stack.name: Redeploy stack
redeploy_stack.description: Deploys a Portainer stack again from its compose file, optionally pulling newer images first. A service picks its stack.

device_id.name: Target
device_id.description: Stacks, or services whose stack to redeploy.

pull_image.name: Pull images
pull_image.description: Pull the latest image for each service before deploying.

prune.name: Prune
prune.description: Remove services that are no longer in the compose file.

start.name: Start
start.description: Starts a stopped Portainer stack or a container.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops a Portainer stack (its services are removed until it is started again) or a container.

scale_service.name: Scale service
scale_service.description: Sets the number of replicas of a replicated service. 0 stops it without removing it.

rollback_service.name: Roll back service
rollback_service.description: Returns a service to its previous spec, like `docker service rollback`.

remove_service.name: Remove service
remove_service.description: Removes a swarm service. With recreate on, its stack is then redeployed so the service comes back fresh (new tasks, networks re-attached).

recreate.name: Recreate
recreate.description: Redeploy the stack after removing, so the service is created again.

set_node_availability.name: Set node availability
set_node_availability.description: Sets a swarm node to active, pause (no new tasks) or drain (moves its tasks to other nodes).
